first-galactic-war.title: First Galactic War
first-galactic-war.description: The First Galactic War was a roughly forty-year conflict fought by the Super Earth Federation against the Bugs, Cyborgs, and Illuminate. The Helldivers fought across all three fronts, and the war ultimately ended in Super Earth victory. The Bugs were placed into farms for Element 710 production, the defeated Cyborgs were forced to labor on Cyberstan, and the Illuminate were defeated and believed to have been eradicated.

second-galactic-war.title: Second Galactic War
second-galactic-war.description: The Second Galactic War began around 2184 after approximately a century of relative peace following the First Galactic War. Terminids escaped containment and spread through the eastern sectors while the Automaton Legion emerged in the west, prompting Super Earth to reactivate the Helldivers. The conflict later expanded further with the return of the Illuminate, creating a galaxy-wide war fought across multiple fronts.

operation-valiant-enclosure.title: Operation Valiant Enclosure
operation-valiant-enclosure.description: Operation Valiant Enclosure was a major Super Earth campaign against the Terminids during the early Second Galactic War. Helldivers fought to secure the Barrier Planets of Erata Prime, Fenrir III, Meridia, and Turing, where the Terminid Control System was constructed and activated. The TCS dispersed Termicide in an attempt to contain the Terminid threat. Although initially declared a success, some Terminids adapted to the chemical, contributing to explosive reproduction and the eventual transformation of Meridia into a Supercolony.

operation-swift-disassembly.title: Operation Swift Disassembly
operation-swift-disassembly.description: Operation Swift Disassembly was a multi-phase Super Earth offensive intended to completely eradicate the Automatons. Helldivers captured a long-range communications array on Troost, attacked Automaton production centers, defended key worlds against a counterattack, and finally assaulted the remaining Automaton planets of Maia, Tibit, and Durgen. The operation appeared successful when the Automaton vanguard was eliminated, but the victory was short-lived: a much larger Automaton fleet soon invaded during the Reclamation.

the-reclamation.title: The Reclamation
the-reclamation.description: The Reclamation began on April 9, 2184, only two days after Super Earth believed the Automatons had been eradicated. A massive Automaton invasion fleet arrived from beyond the Galactic Frontier and overwhelmed Super Earth defenses across the Valdis region. The invading force dwarfed the Automaton vanguard destroyed during Operation Swift Disassembly and rapidly captured Cyberstan, revealing that the earlier Automaton armies had represented only a fraction of their true strength.

operation-enduring-peace.title: Operation Enduring Peace
operation-enduring-peace.description: Operation Enduring Peace was Super Earth's campaign to destroy the Terminid Supercolony on Meridia. Helldivers first secured the surrounding staging worlds before deploying weaponized Dark Fluid into Meridia's crust. Once enough Dark Fluid had been injected, the planet collapsed, destroying the Supercolony and leaving the Meridian Black Hole in its place.

battle-of-calypso.title: Battle of Calypso
battle-of-calypso.description: The Battle of Calypso marked the return of the Illuminate to open warfare after more than a century. Illuminate forces emerged through the Meridian anomaly and launched a surprise invasion of the Super Earth colony on Calypso. The attackers deployed Overseers, Harvesters, and hordes of Voteless created from abducted and transformed human colonists. Helldivers were ordered to Calypso under LIBCON 1 and fought for roughly three days before successfully repelling the invasion.

the-great-host.title: The Great Host
the-great-host.description: The Great Host was a massive Illuminate invasion fleet constructed in secret beyond the Meridian Wormhole. After the Meridian Singularity was halted, the fleet emerged and began advancing toward Super Earth, bringing new Illuminate forces including Stingrays, Fleshmobs, Crescent Overseers, Leviathans, and Overships. The Great Host eventually reached the Solar System and launched the Illuminate assault on Super Earth before being destroyed during the Battle for Super Earth.

battle-for-super-earth.title: First Battle for Super Earth
battle-for-super-earth.description: The First Battle for Super Earth began on May 20, 2185 when the Illuminate Great Host reached humanity's homeworld and assaulted its Mega Cities. Helldivers and SEAF forces fought an eleven-day defense as Eagleopolis, Remembrance, Administrative Center 02, Port Mercy, and York Supreme were destroyed. Despite enormous losses and the death of the President of Super Earth, the defenders reduced the Great Host to a fraction of its original strength. On the final day, the Illuminate withdrew, leaving Prosperity City and Equality-on-Sea standing and Super Earth under Federation control.

great-host-remnants.title: Remnants of the Great Host
great-host-remnants.description: After their defeat during the First Battle for Super Earth, the surviving Illuminate forces activated cloaking technology and withdrew from the homeworld. Super Earth scientists later studied captured Illuminate wreckage and developed methods to detect the cloaked enemy. Hidden Illuminate positions were subsequently discovered in the southern galaxy, proving that the defeat of the Great Host had not ended the Illuminate threat.

operation-righteous-reclamation.title: Operation Righteous Reclamation
operation-righteous-reclamation.description: Operation Righteous Reclamation was Super Earth's major offensive into the Gloom. Beginning in August 2185, Helldivers were ordered to penetrate the massive Terminid spore cloud and establish a permanent forward operating base within its perimeter. Hellmire was liberated and Outpost Alpha was established, giving the Helldiver fleet unprecedented access to the interior of the Gloom. From there, spore-flow analysis led Super Earth to Oshaune, a planet transformed by extreme Terminid terraformation into a Hive World. The operation then expanded into reconnaissance, research, and combat operations against the mutated Terminids hidden within the Gloom.

operation-valid-pretext.title: Operation Valid Pretext
operation-valid-pretext.description: Operation Valid Pretext was a multi-phase Super Earth campaign launched in February 2186 to invade Cyberstan and prevent the Automaton Legion from developing a planet-destroying weapon using stolen Star of Peace plans. The operation culminated in the liberation campaign for Cyberstan.

operation-permanent-enclosure.title: Operation Permanent Enclosure
operation-permanent-enclosure.description: Operation Permanent Enclosure was a major Super Earth campaign launched on July 28, 2186 to expand the Terminid Control System+ defensive wall. Helldivers secured and defended planets while additional TCS+ arrays were constructed and activated to prevent further Terminid expansion into Super Earth territory. Super Earth High Command declared the operation successfully completed on August 11, 2186.

operation-void-piercer.title: Operation Void Piercer
operation-void-piercer.description: Operation Void Piercer was a major Super Earth campaign conducted from August 12 to August 23, 2186 to penetrate and destroy the Illuminate-created Void. Helldivers first defended Rirga Bay and secured E-711 needed to activate the Void Warp Relay. Super Earth forces then entered the anomaly, explored its obscured worlds, gathered scientific data to locate its hidden source, and advanced to the Void Source Planet. The campaign concluded after Helldivers secured the planet while a Ministry of Science expedition destroyed the source from within, causing the Void to dissipate across the galaxy.

war-on-dissidence.title: War on Dissidence
war-on-dissidence.description: The War on Dissidence is a Super Earth campaign against widespread internal dissidence discovered throughout Federation territory. The crisis followed investigations by the Center for Civilian Surveillance and Safety, which found evidence of dissident activity across Super Earth-controlled planets. SEAF forces and Ministry of Unity enforcement units conducted large-scale apprehension operations while the Helldivers maintained the external Galactic War fronts. The campaign also resulted in the construction of the Center for the Confinement of Dissidence on Afoyay Bay.

operation-free-space.title: Operation Free Space
operation-free-space.description: Operation Free Space was a Super Earth strategic initiative to dramatically upgrade the Democracy Space Station through construction of the Star of Peace. The operation centered on Pandora Base at Afoyay Bay and required massive quantities of E-711, platinum, and salvaged Automaton components. Its centerpiece was an ionized Dark Fluid weapon capable of collapsing an entire planet into a black hole. The operation concluded when Helldivers voted for Penta as the first target and the Star of Peace successfully destroyed the planet.

battle-for-super-earth.title: Battle for Super Earth
battle-for-super-earth.description: The Battle for Super Earth was the massive 2185 defense of humanity's homeworld against the Illuminate Great Host. The invasion developed into a prolonged struggle across Super Earth's seven Mega Cities, forcing High Command to activate the Super Defense Protocols as casualties and infrastructure losses mounted. Eagleopolis, Administrative Center 02, Remembrance, Port Mercy, and York Supreme were destroyed. During the final assault on Prosperity City, the President of Super Earth was killed. Helldivers and SEAF forces ultimately broke the invasion with assistance from the repaired Democracy Space Station, leaving Prosperity City and Equality-on-Sea as the two surviving Mega Cities.

super-defense-protocols.title: Super Defense Protocols
super-defense-protocols.description: The Super Defense Protocols are emergency global defense measures reserved for situations in which Super Earth itself faces an extreme military threat. They were activated during the 2185 Battle for Super Earth as the Illuminate destroyed Mega Cities and overwhelmed planetary defenses. Protocol Sapphire converted Super Earth's remaining rainforests into tactical Eagle airstrips, Protocol Diamond suspended Collateral Damage Mitigation Procedures and provided Orbital Napalm Barrages, and Protocol Ruby opened Super Destroyer high-cost reserves and provided Fast Recon Vehicles.

great-host.title: The Great Host
great-host.description: The Great Host was a massive Illuminate invasion fleet that emerged from the Meridian Wormhole in 2185 and launched a direct campaign against Super Earth. Believed to have been prepared over the century following the First Galactic War, the fleet advanced through Federation territory before reaching the Solar System and invading humanity's homeworld. The Great Host destroyed five of Super Earth's seven Mega Cities and killed the sitting President before its fleet strength was exhausted by Helldiver and SEAF resistance, the Democracy Space Station, and a devastating cyberattack. Its surviving forces retreated from Super Earth and later established themselves in the southern reaches of the known galaxy.

eagle-blockade.title: Eagle Blockade
eagle-blockade.description: Eagle Blockade was a temporary Democracy Space Station Tactical Action deployed during the Battle for Super Earth. It combined the effects of Eagle Storm and Orbital Blockade, maintaining a rotating fleet of Eagle Fighters over Super Earth while providing logistical support to Super Destroyers. During missions it produced periodic Eagle Strafing Runs and automatically supplied Hellpod Space Optimization. Its activation helped relieve severe logistical problems and inflicted heavy losses on the Illuminate during the final stages of the Great Host invasion.

fort-union-cyberattack.title: Fort Union Cyberattack
fort-union-cyberattack.description: The Fort Union Cyberattack was a decisive cyberwarfare operation conducted during the final stages of the Battle for Super Earth. A former satellite technician on Fort Union developed malware capable of disabling Illuminate technology, but a Terminid attack threatened the planet before the code could be deployed. Helldivers successfully defended Fort Union, allowing long-range satellites to transmit the malware. The attack disabled approximately five percent of the Great Host, and the technician responsible was promoted to command the 405th Cyberwarfare Detachment.

battle-for-super-earth-aftermath.title: Aftermath of the Battle for Super Earth
battle-for-super-earth-aftermath.description: The Battle for Super Earth ended on the eleventh day of the Illuminate invasion when the Great Host's remaining fleet strength was depleted and its forces retreated. Five of Super Earth's seven Mega Cities had been destroyed, leaving only Prosperity City and Equality-on-Sea standing. The sitting President had been killed, and a new President was subsequently elected in a landslide Managed Election. Surviving Great Host forces activated cloaking technology and escaped into the southern galaxy. Super Earth later began reconstruction of its devastated cities while continuing operations to locate and destroy the Illuminate remnants.
aliases: end of battle for super earth

great-democratization.title: The Great Democratization
great-democratization.description: The Great Democratization was the approximately century-long period of expansion and relative peace following Super Earth's victory in the First Galactic War. With its major enemies defeated, Super Earth expanded its colonies throughout the galaxy. The surviving Cyborgs were imprisoned and forced to work the mines of Cyberstan, the Bugs were placed into farms for Element-710 production, and the Illuminate were believed by the Federation to have been eliminated. The era ended as new conflicts with the Terminids and Automatons developed into the Second Galactic War.
